Anthony was terrific. He took.spme measurements and shared the results with me. All vales were within spec indicating the HVAC is working fine. Thank you Ed. I enjoyed our conversation too. 😊

Response from the owner:Thank you for the 5-star review, Michael! We're glad we could take a look at that sink clog for you, and we appreciate you choosing Service Professionals.
Myrna Gasmena
a day ago
Victor
Response from the owner:Myrna, thank you so much for the 5-star rating! We truly appreciate it.
Laura H
a day ago
On 10/16/26 DJ White serviced my Generac generator. As I have maintained a Partnership Plan with Service Professional for a number of years, as part of the yearly service, DJ inspected the spark plugs and air filter which were not in need of being replace at the time and changed the oil and oil filter. He kept me informed of his progress and was professional and courteous. Upon completion, I was sent an email with my invoice and a full set of pictures which covered the inside and outside of the generator. Thank you to DJ, and thank you Service Professional.
Then on 10/28/28 Service Professionals Justin Crespo and Nick Horzempa arrived at my residence to perform the yearly service of my gas heater. Both men were extremely professional and courteous. Justin performed the inspection of the heating system and took the time to explain just how my heating system worked, and what specific readings indicated that could ultimately identify potential or present issues. Luckily there were none. Upon completion, Justin sent my invoice, and a full series of pictures of the inside and outside of the heater for my records. Again, many thanks to Justin, Nick, and all who have serviced my heating, ac, and generator over the years.
Response from the owner:Laura, thank you for taking the time to write such an amazing review! We take great pride in providing that type of service every time, and Joe is a prime example of the talent we have here! We're so glad you chose us to come out to service you and we're even happier to have you as a customer for all of your plumbing, heating, cooling, and electrical needs!
Michael Pollack
a day ago
Always have had a good experience with Service Professionals. Recently with Brayan was no different, as he walked the home for an electrical inspection and took great care to make sure all GF(C)I throughout the home were working as they should.
Since we moved in around June 2015, we've used everyone over at Service Professionals: Dan A., Ray, Shimul, Carlos, Joaquin C., Paul R., Kevin S., Latrell, Daniel, Kelvin, George A., Zak S., Jon F., Chris, Kayla, Ed, Ron, Christian, James, Tony, Bill C., Mike, Matt, Scott B., Rich C., Patrick, Javier, Vissia etc. just to name a few ! That's probably 85 percent of their roster over time!!!
Despite buying what was deemed to be a move-in-ready home in Fanwood, the house has needed a lot of TLC in terms of servicing what had been mostly original plumbing and HVAC components. Service Pros have probably spent more time than they care to admit at our place, but they are always top-notch, efficient, polite, and dependable.
If a boiler or sewer replacement forces them to start at 7 a.m. and work through 10:30 p.m., they will do so in order to see a job through to its completion.
They have encountered old units galore, not to mention an original sewer line that was degrading and wearing down. But they always came prepared to work and treated me and my family well. I wouldn't spend (and finance !) the crazy amount we have over 11 years if I didn't feel the workers were of the highest caliber and reliability.
In particular, want to give a shout-out to Scott for spending many days and many hours at our place. He encountered a lot of difficulties but always found a way to plow through. Thanks, guys !
Response from the owner:Michael thank you for taking the time to write this amazing review! We will always do whatever it takes to make sure our customers are completely satisfied and taken care of! Thank you for being our customer we appreciate you so much!
Adam Gemmell
a day ago
John and Manny helped me figure out the heating and cooling systems to my new house. Taking the time to make sure I understood everything going on. Highly recommended. Will be reaching out again in the future!
Response from the owner:Thank you, Adam! We're glad John and Manny took the time to walk you through the heating and cooling systems in your new house. Congratulations on the new home, and we'll be here whenever you need us.
Nikkee M.
a day ago
Love these guys. They were on time, professional, courteous, diligent, clean, knowledgeable and organized. It was worth the money spent. I would recommend them to anyone. The installation was art work.
Response from the owner:Thank you for your great review!
Duke Parker
a day ago
Service professionals have serviced my home for several years. They are the best for HVAC, Plumbing, Electrical, and unit replacement. They replaced my broken water heater with a tankless system 3 years ago and their annual maintenance of that unit is excellent. I highly recommend them!
Response from the owner:Maurice appreciates your kind words, Duke! Glad to hear he could provide valuable insights and excellent service.

About Service Professionals
About Service Professionals

Growing up in the 1980s, my Dad used me as free labor on his renovation projects he did as a side-gig.

And honestly, I was happy to do it. Dad taught me a ton about working with customers, doing quality work, and persevering to finish the job properly.

That’s how I learned what it meant to do a thumbs up job. But when one of our clients offered to hire me as an apprentice plumber, the choice was pretty easy: paid work beats unpaid.

Turns out, I love plumbing.
Of the great loves of my life, plumbing is #2.

Yeah, that’s a dad joke. But it’s true. And, yes, I’m not only a dad but a granddad, so I’m certified to tell those kind of jokes.

Anyway, back in the 80s and 90s, plumbers and other home contractors had a lousy reputation. Ask the average Joe on the street what he associated with plumbers, and he’d have told you “butt cracks.”

And I simply wasn’t going to have anything to do with that. Plumbing wasn’t just my trade – it was my career and profession. So I bucked that trend hard by insisting on hiring only the best people. Wearing uniforms. Driving clean, nicely painted and well-stocked trucks. And always doing right by customers.

It’s why I named the Company Service Professionals – ’cause that’s what we are.

And why our logo is a uniformed man, giving you the thumbs up, saying, “yes, you can count on us. Yes, we can fix it right, right here and now.”

The same vision is also why I went a few years without pay during our start-up rather than cutting any corners on first class service and doing right by customers.

Now, four decades and change later, we’re not only first-rate, professional plumbers, but Heating and Cooling techs and electricians as well.

Basically, if something goes wrong with any major system in your home, you can call us and count on professional, thumbs-up service.
